div#root "openJevARCADEICP CANISTERON-CANISTER INF" has a dragstart handler but is not draggable, so the handler can never fire — the browser starts no drag on an element whose `draggable` is false. Add `draggable="true"` (or move the handler to an element that is draggable by default, like an or ).
